products.body:
The Osprey Exos 38 is a men’s ultralight backpacking pack for overnight trips and streamlined weekends. Its AirSpeed suspension provides ventilation and support, with an adjustable torso system for a more tailored fit.

Choose between two sizes, with volumes of 38L and 41L. The removable floating lid has zippered pockets, while the integrated FlapJacket covers the pack when you leave the lid behind.

Stretch mesh pockets keep gear accessible, and hipbelt pockets offer handy storage for trail essentials. Additional attachment points and removable straps give you options for carrying extra equipment.
products.title: Osprey Exos 38 Men's Ultralight Backpack

products.body: Less is more with the Aura AG LT 50, pairing Osprey's extraordinary, ventilated and comfortable AntiGravity suspension with a more streamlined silhouette for technical backpackers. Even lighter than its original counterpart, LT delivers the same best-in-class carry while providing a thoughtfully simple, capable feature set, including an integrated raincover, side panel zip access, floating top lid, reinforced shove-it pocket and internal hydration sleeve. From weekend explorations to weeklong expeditions, Aura AG LT 50 is a backpacking revelation. Made with bluesign® approved, recycled main body fabrics and designed to pass the test of time, no matter where you take it.
